verse.verse_1: AlifLaamRa. Those are the verses of the Book, the Clear Koran.
verse.verse_2: It could be that those who disbelieve will wish that they were Muslims.
verse.verse_3: Let them eat and enjoy; and let their hopes deceive them, soon they shall know.
verse.verse_4: We never destroyed a village whose term had not already been decreed.
verse.verse_5: No nation can outstrip its term, nor do they put it back.
verse.verse_6: They say: 'You to whom the Remembrance is sent down, you are indeed mad.
verse.verse_7: Why do you not bring down the angels, if what you say is true'
verse.verse_8: We do not send angels except with the truth. Then they shall have no respite.
verse.verse_9: It is We who sent down the Koran, and We watch over it.
verse.verse_10: We have sent forth before you Messengers among the factions of the ancients.
verse.verse_11: But no Messenger came to them except he was mocked.
verse.verse_12: So We make it enter the hearts of the sinners.
verse.verse_13: They do not believe in it even though the practice of the ancients has already gone.
verse.verse_14: If We opened a gate in the heaven and they kept ascending through it,
verse.verse_15: still they would say: 'Our eyes were dazzled; truly, we must have been a bewitched people'
verse.verse_16: We have set constellations in the heavens and made them pleasing to the beholders,
verse.verse_17: and guarded them from every stoned satan.
verse.verse_18: Except for he who steals the listening and is then pursued by a visible flame.
verse.verse_19: We have spread out the earth and set upon it firm mountains. Everything We have caused to grow therein is justly weighed;
verse.verse_20: and there appointed for you is a livelihood, and for those you do not provide.
verse.verse_21: And there is not a thing but with Us are its treasuries, and We do not send it down except in a known measure.
verse.verse_22: We send the winds fertilizing, and We send down out of heaven water, from which you drink and you are not its treasurers.
verse.verse_23: And surely, it is We who give life and make to die. We are the Inheritor.
verse.verse_24: We know those of you who press forward, and We know the laggards,
verse.verse_25: and it is your Lord who will gather them. He is Wise, Knowing.
verse.verse_26: We created mankind from clay, molded from mud,
verse.verse_27: and before him We created the jinn from smokeless fire.
verse.verse_28: When your Lord said to the angels: 'See, I am creating a mortal from clay of molded mud.
verse.verse_29: When I have shaped him and ran My created soul in him fall down prostrating towards him'.
verse.verse_31: except iblis (father of the jinn) who refused to be one of those who prostrated themselves.
verse.verse_32: He said: 'iblis, what is the matter with you, that you do you not prostrate yourself'
verse.verse_33: He replied: 'I will not prostrate to a mortal You have created of clay, from molded mud'
verse.verse_35: A curse shall be on you till the Day of Recompense'
verse.verse_36: He said: 'My Lord, reprieve me till the Day they are raised'
verse.verse_37: He answered: 'You are among those reprieved
verse.verse_39: (satan) said: 'My Lord, for Your perverting me, I shall make (matters) in the earth seem most fair to them and I shall pervert all,
verse.verse_40: except the devoted amongst Your worshippers.
verse.verse_41: He (Allah) said: 'This is for Me the Right Path
verse.verse_42: over My worshipers you have no authority, except the perverse that follow you.
verse.verse_43: Gehenna (Hell) will be the promise for all of them.
verse.verse_44: It has seven gates, and through each gate a portion of them belong.
verse.verse_45: But the cautious shall live amongst gardens and fountains:
verse.verse_47: We shall remove all rancor from their hearts, and as brethren they shall recline on couches face to face.
verse.verse_48: There, no fatigue shall smite them, nor shall they ever be driven from it'
verse.verse_49: Tell My worshipers that I am the Forgiving, the Most Merciful,
verse.verse_50: and that My punishment is the painful chastisement.
verse.verse_52: They entered to him and said: 'Peace' but he replied: 'We are afraid of you'
verse.verse_53: 'Do not be afraid' they answered. 'We come to give you glad tidings of a knowledgeable child'
verse.verse_54: He said: 'What is this, do you bring me glad tidings even though I am old' Of what do you give me glad tidings'
verse.verse_55: They replied: 'In truth we have given you glad tidings, do not be one of those who despair'
verse.verse_56: He replied: 'And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, except those that are astray?
verse.verse_57: He asked: 'Messengers, what is your errand'
verse.verse_58: They replied: 'We are sent to sinful nation.
verse.verse_59: Except Lot's family, of whom we shall save all,
verse.verse_60: but his wife. We decreed that she should be amongst those who remain behind.
verse.verse_61: And when the envoys came to the family of Lot,
verse.verse_62: he said to them: 'I do not know you'
verse.verse_63: 'No' they replied: 'We bring you (news) of that concerning which they were doubting.
verse.verse_64: We bring you the truth, and indeed we are truthful.
verse.verse_65: Depart with your family in a part of the night and walk behind them and let none of you turn round. Go to a place where you are commanded'
verse.verse_66: And We made known to him this decree that the wrongdoers were to be utterly cut off in the morning.
verse.verse_67: The people of the city came to him rejoicing.
verse.verse_68: He said: 'These are my guests; do not shame me.
verse.verse_69: Fear Allah and do not disgrace me'
verse.verse_70: They replied: 'Have we not forbidden you (the people of) the worlds'
verse.verse_71: He said: 'Here are my daughters; take them (in marriage), if you would be doing'
verse.verse_72: By your life, they wandered blindly in their dazzlement.
verse.verse_73: At sunrise a dreadful Shout seized them.
verse.verse_74: We laid it (the city) upside down and rained stones of baked clay upon them.
verse.verse_75: Surely, in that there are signs for those who contemplate.
verse.verse_76: Indeed, it is on a way which still exists.
verse.verse_77: Surely, in that there is a sign for those who believe.
verse.verse_78: The dwellers of the Thicket were harmdoers.
verse.verse_79: On them, too, We took vengeance, and they are both on a clear roadway.
verse.verse_80: And the dwellers of Al Hijr also belied the Messengers.
verse.verse_81: We brought them signs, but they turned away.
verse.verse_82: They hewed their dwellings out of the mountains in safety.
verse.verse_83: But the Shout seized them in the morning,
verse.verse_84: and that which they had earned did not help them.
verse.verse_85: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and what is between them except in truth. The Hour is sure to come, therefore, forgive them with a graciouspardon.
verse.verse_86: Your Lord is the Creator, the Knower.
verse.verse_87: We have given you the seven dual (verses, Al Fatihah) and the Mighty Holy Reading (Koran).
verse.verse_88: Do not stretch your eyes to that We have given pairs of them to enjoy, nor sorrow for them, and lower your wing to the believers.
verse.verse_89: And say: 'I am the plain warner'
verse.verse_90: So We sent it down to the partitioners,
verse.verse_91: who have broken the Koran into parts,
verse.verse_92: so by your Lord, We will question them all
verse.verse_94: Proclaim then, what you are commanded and turn away from the unbelievers.
verse.verse_95: We suffice you against those who mock,
verse.verse_96: and those who set up other gods with Allah, indeed, they will soon know.
verse.verse_97: Indeed, We know your chest is straitened by that they say.
verse.verse_98: Exalt with the praise of your Lord and be one of those who prostrate.
verse.verse_99: Worship your Lord till the certainty (death) comes to you.
